result.title: Latent Projection for Latent Planning
result.comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Modeling Uncertainty in Robotic World Models
result.summary: Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 latent world model 规划中 ℓ2 目标 latent 代价受噪声干扰的问题，利用 SIGReg 使各步 latent 边缘分布趋于标准高斯并假设 Gauss-Markov 转移，从状态动力学矩阵 A 直接得到协方差，再用约束为正规矩阵后的稳定特征基，将规划代价限制在不确定度最小的 k 维子空间，编码器、预测器与规划器均不改动，仅在六个环境中评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 按方向不确定度划分 latent 子空间并剔除无信号维度的做法，可能为 LVR 中区分承载视觉与任务必要信息的 latent 方向、以及评价 latent 相似度时的噪声干扰提供可核查线索，但其场景是控制规划而非 VLM 推理，迁移性仍需判断。
